title: Sky Relay
description: A remote community needs a dependable communications relay. Inspired by stratospheric cell-tower trials, keep your Radio Repeater powered above 16 km and cover the entire community, a 10 km radius around the launch field, for a total of 30 minutes. Choose your own gas, envelope, and fill. Only connected time counts: climbing out of range, drifting away, or losing battery power interrupts service.

objectives.description: Provide 30 minutes of powered coverage to the whole community from at least 16 km altitude.
